title: New task
statementMd:
On the 228-th international Uzhlyandian Wars strategic game tournament teams from each country are called. The teams should consist of $5$ participants.

The team of Uzhlyandia will consist of soldiers, because there are no gamers.

Masha is a new minister of defense and gaming. The prime duty of the minister is to calculate the efficiency of the Uzhlandian army. The army consists of $*n*$ soldiers standing in a row, enumerated from $1$ to $*n*$. For each soldier we know his *skill* in Uzhlyandian Wars: the $*i*$-th soldier's skill is $*a*_{*i*}$.

It was decided that the team will consist of three players and two assistants. The skills of players should be same, and the assistants' skills should not be greater than the players' skill. Moreover, it is important for Masha that one of the assistants should stand in the row to the left of the players, and the other one should stand in the row to the right of the players. Formally, a team is five soldiers with indexes $*i*$, $*j*$, $*k*$, $*l*$, $*p*$, such that $1 ≤ *i* < *j* < *k* < *l* < *p* ≤ *n*$ and $*a*_{*i*} ≤ *a*_{*j*} = *a*_{*k*} = *a*_{*l*} ≥ *a*_{*p*}$.

The efficiency of the army is the number of different teams Masha can choose. Two teams are considered different if there is such $*i*$ such that the $*i*$-th soldier is a member of one team, but not a member of the other team.

Initially, all players are able to be players. For some reasons, sometimes some soldiers become unable to be players. Sometimes some soldiers, that were unable to be players, become able to be players. At any time any soldier is able to be an assistant. Masha wants to control the efficiency of the army, so she asked you to tell her the number of different possible teams modulo $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$) after each change.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of soldiers in Uzhlyandia.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the soldiers' skills.

The third line contains single integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of changes.

The next $*m*$ lines contain the changes, each change is described with two integers $*t*$ and $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2$, $1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$) on a separate line. If $*t* = 1$, then the $*x*$-th soldier is unable to be a player after this change. If $*t* = 2$, then the $*x*$-th soldier is able to be a player after this change.

It is guaranteed that before each query of the first type the soldier is able to be a player, and before each query of the second type the soldier is unable to be a player.

## Output

Print $*m*$ integers — the number of distinct teams after each change.

Print the answers modulo $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$).

## Note

In the first example, after the first change the only team consists of soldiers $[1, 2, 4, 5, 6]$. After the second change any five soldiers can form a team.

In the first example after the first change the only team is soldiers $[1, 2, 3, 7, 8]$. After the second change the possible teams are: $[1, 2, 3, 5, 7]$, $[1, 2, 3, 5, 8]$, $[1, 2, 3, 7, 8]$, $[1, 2, 5, 7, 8]$, $[1, 3, 5, 7, 8]$, $[2, 3, 5, 7, 8]$. After the third change the possible teams are: $[1, 3, 5, 7, 8]$, $[2, 3, 5, 7, 8]$.
statementZhMd:
在第 228 届国际乌兹兰战争战略游戏锦标赛中，每个国家都将派出队伍参赛。每支队伍应由 $5$ 名参赛者组成。

由于乌兹兰没有游戏玩家，乌兹兰的队伍将由士兵组成。

玛莎是新任国防与游戏部长。部长的首要职责是计算乌兹兰军队的效率。军队由站成一排的 *n* 名士兵组成，编号从 $1$ 到 *n*。对于每名士兵，我们知道他在乌兹兰战争中的*技能*：第 *i* 名士兵的技能为 *a*_{*i*}。

经过决定，队伍将由三名选手和两名助手组成。三名选手的技能必须相同，且两名助手的技能不能高于选手的技能。此外，玛莎还要求其中一名助手站在选手左侧，另一名助手站在选手右侧。形式化地说，一个队伍由编号为 *i*、*j*、*k*、*l*、*p* 的五名士兵组成，满足 $1 ≤ *i* < *j* < *k* < *l* < *p* ≤ *n*$ 且 $*a*_{*i*} ≤ *a*_{*j*} = *a*_{*k*} = *a*_{*l*} ≥ *a*_{*p*}$。

军队的效率是玛莎可以选择的不同队伍的数量。如果存在某个 *i*，使得第 *i* 名士兵属于其中一个队伍但不属于另一个队伍，则认为这两个队伍不同。

最初，所有士兵都可以担任选手。由于某些原因，有时一些士兵会变得不能担任选手；有时，一些原本不能担任选手的士兵又会恢复资格。在任何时候，所有士兵都可以担任助手。玛莎希望掌握军队的效率，因此她请你在每次变化后告诉她不同可行队伍的数量，并将结果对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 *n*（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——乌兹兰士兵的数量。

第二行包含 *n* 个整数 *a*_{1}、*a*_{2}、...、*a*_{*n*}（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——士兵们的技能。

第三行包含一个整数 *m*（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）——变化的次数。

接下来的 *m* 行每行包含两个整数 *t* 和 *x*（$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2$，$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n$），表示一次变化。如果 *t* = 1，则第 *x* 名士兵在此次变化后不能担任选手。如果 *t* = 2，则第 *x* 名士兵在此次变化后可以担任选手。

保证在每次第一类查询之前，该士兵可以担任选手；在每次第二类查询之前，该士兵不能担任选手。

## 输出格式

输出 *m* 个整数——每次变化后的不同队伍数量。

将答案对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一次变化后，唯一的队伍由士兵 $[1, 2, 4, 5, 6]$ 组成。第二次变化后，任意五名士兵都可以组成一个队伍。

在第一个样例中，第一次变化后，唯一的队伍是士兵 $[1, 2, 3, 7, 8]$。第二次变化后，可行的队伍为：$[1, 2, 3, 5, 7]$、$[1, 2, 3, 5, 8]$、$[1, 2, 3, 7, 8]$、$[1, 2, 5, 7, 8]$、$[1, 3, 5, 7, 8]$、$[2, 3, 5, 7, 8]$。第三次变化后，可行的队伍为：$[1, 3, 5, 7, 8]$、$[2, 3, 5, 7, 8]$。
